title: I caused an accident under the bridge in my dream world and I woke up feeling guilty.
content: &#x200B; [So this is an AI pic, I tried to get it as close as I could to my actual bridge.](https://preview.redd.it/5gcfzy5abgdc1.jpg?width=1024&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=c70c999954453acbae24661043a10bd7ec29d510) My dream bridge is red brick and pretty much looks the same as the picture except it's much wider. The road is wide enough for 4 lanes of traffic on each side and the only markings are the white lines in the middle. There's no markings or pavements on the side. It's just road where no-one is really allowed to walk. Also the bridge is not only wider across to span the wide road, it's also wider width wise as well as the road that runs over the top is wide enough to have 4 lanes on each side so the 'tunnel' would be around 20 metres wide. It's two big wide roads that form a cross shape pretty much in the middle of my map. just beyond the bridge on the right hand side is a little turn off that's like a road but not really a road, it kind of leads off to an old abandoned garage and then curves back onto the main road although I wasn't able to put the little turn off into the picture. Anyway, on with the story. The dream was super vivid but I wouldn't say it was lucid. I first posted this on the dream cartography page and someone told me it would be better to post it here so here is the original post: So in my dream world there's this huge wide road. It's easily wide enough for 4 lanes of traffic on either side. There's very little traffic though, just a few cars now and again so the road is just split into two lanes, white lines down the middle. People drive on the left. There's a 20 metre section that is under a bridge. Over the bridge runs another wide road, the same width as the one underneath. The structure of the bridge underneath is red brick, the old Accrington bricks it looks like, the old genuine original ones. Anyway, there's no pavements on this road, it's just road. It doesn't matter usually because the road is so very wide and so very quiet usually. So I was walking down the road last night, I was walking on the right so I'd see any cars coming towards me because I don't like the thought of cars coming up behind me. a few cars came past easily, they were closer to the middle of the road so a long way from me. Then suddenly, a line of 4 cars turned onto the road, I was under the bridge walking against the wall, there was nowhere for me to move, just beyond the bridge on the right is a tiny road that hardly anyone ever uses and the cars turned down that all in a line. The second car was towing a small old fashioned boat. They turned really tight right up against the wall close to where I was walking. They had plenty of room to be away from the wall, but it was still my fault as we're not supposed to walk on that bit of road. They were about to hit me but they all swerved towards the middle. It would have been fine but the guy with the boat, his boat tipped to one side and the car behind hit it. And the car behind that hit the one in front. Everyone got out of their cars and the boat guy looked angry so I ran. I know I shouldn't have, but I just legged it and went down the little road just beyond the bridge. I could hear two of the guys yelling "where is she?" "she should have waited" I'll try to make a drawing of the bridge and road, but I have zero art skills. But if anyone recognises it from the description, feel free to chime in. :)
